title: 第25章 画中画第26章 所谓专家
content_zh:
“见过没？”
李子茜幸灾乐祸看向江凡，要是哪个奸商敢碰瓷碰到姑奶奶头上，姑奶奶就放江凡，不，让保镖江凡揍的店老板生活不能自理！
江凡暗翻白眼，碰瓷在修真界坊市司空见惯，修士比凡人更狠，不仅讹诈散修的灵石和天材地宝，而且很多时候顺带着杀人灭口，玩味看向李富婆，好心提醒道：“老祖宗说的好，玉不过手，金不离目，手不指鱼。”
“没看出来，你连碰瓷行当也门清，告诉你一种更阴险的碰瓷手法，一些黑心店家用鱼线或丝线绑在一些易碎裂的瓷器或赝品或残次品上，防不胜防，没有个几万块钱走不出店铺。”
“城市套路深，我要回农村！”
江凡笑着说道，燕京的商家心也太黑了些，如此阴损的办法也能想出来，雷电怎么不劈死那些缺德冒烟的商家。
“年轻人，农村路也滑，套路更复杂！”
李子茜打趣道，如今的农村百姓可没有以前那么纯朴，不少进城打工的农民工，有的为了搏一把大的，甚至连行驶的汽车也敢碰瓷！
闲聊几句，碰瓷的热闹也没什么好看，游客也只能认栽，吃一堑长一智，以后不要来古玩市场这种鱼龙混杂的地方，就是来也要进那些装修不错老店铺，或者到地摊上淘宝。
两人有说有笑进入一家字画店铺，扫了眼墙上和柜台里的字画，仔细一看落款处，江凡嘴角忍不住狠狠抽搐，电视剧照进现实，真的令人大开眼界。
怎么说呢，店铺的老板肯定是苏村某位大佬的亲戚，店里的字画多是苏村或金陵一些大佬临摹名家的作品，售价几万至几十万不等，懂的都懂。
离开字画店铺，李子茜内心一阵鄙夷，金陵这边玩的太低端了些，全是燕京那边玩剩下的，神秘莫测看向江凡，“你知道燕京那边是怎么玩的吗？”
唉，本姑娘给你传授点大学问，这些学问可是只有内行人才知道，颇为无语说道：“知道年初（2003年2月16日）福利彩票上市的新彩票双色球吧，彩票史上第一个统一游戏规则、统一开奖、统一奖池的全国联合销售的乐透型彩票游戏。”
“燕京那边的一些倒爷，在全国各地收购一等奖彩票，只要你中了一等奖，不用缴纳25%的个税，那帮倒爷以500万开奖价，甚至溢价收购中奖彩票，后面你懂的。”
江凡默默竖起大拇指，燕京不愧是帝都，佩服说道：“金陵的黄牛还在倒腾火车票、专家号和演唱会门票，你们燕京的倒爷开始在全国倒腾双色球彩票，硬生生把福利彩票搞成洗钱工具，佩服佩服！”
李子茜诧异看向江凡，江凡只是一个普通大学生，江母也只是上不得台面的小老板，可江凡怎么对官场的那些破事门清？难道这也是遭雷劈的福利？
走进一家古色古香的字画店铺，扫了眼墙上悬挂的近代字画，李子茜禁不住郁闷叹息，正如日本‘经营四圣’稻盛和夫所说，选择胜于努力，眼光决定未来！
为响应改革开放号召，国家历史博物馆于1981年成立外宾接待部，工作人员常要自掏腰包贴补三块钱餐标，为筹集招待经费，只能把仓库里积压的9000多幅书画以白菜价处理。
李可染的精品标价八元嫌贵，吴作人、陆俨少等人的画作五元无人问津，黄宾虹的画1元滞销，而张大千、齐白石、徐悲鸿、吴冠中、傅抱石等大师作品也不过十来元，两年时间卖出不足百余张书面。
真心羡慕不来，齐白石关门弟子许麟庐的儿子许化迟，作为跟班陪同澳门大丰银行董事长夫妇访华，见到博物馆那些滞销的字画，耗资20万打包9000多幅书画，未来那些字画恐怕价值数亿天价吧！

李芷若禁不住暗暗叹息，当时全国各地的博物馆、友谊商店、文物商店、广交会等官方机构出售到海外的古玩只是洒洒水，鼎盛时期的潘家园汇聚50余家外国古玩经销商，年交易额更是一度突破30亿大关！
“李富婆，李富婆，想什么呢？”
呃，有点走思，李子茜尴尬看向江凡，感慨说道：“想起一件事情，去年故宫花2999万在日本的一场拍卖会上拍下出自米芾之手的《研山铭》，一共39个字，单字价值超76万！”
江凡一时之间竟然无言以对，某些机构从民间获得珍贵文物向来都是一张荣誉证书和五百元奖金，而故宫居然斥资三千万在日本拍卖会竞拍文物……
“不知道米芾是谁？”
李子茜玩味看向江凡，怎么说你也是接受过九年义务的少年，不会连‘宋四家’之一的米芾也不知道吧！
“五色水，浮昆仑；潭在顶，出黑云；挂龙怪，烁电痕；下震霆，泽厚坤；极变化，阖道门！”
江凡鄙夷扫了眼李子茜，哥把图书馆里的书籍差不多翻了个遍，真正的学富五车，岂是尔等凡夫俗子可比！
“what？”
李子茜一脸懵逼看向江凡，没文化不可怕，勇于承认即可，可你读的内容是什么鬼，掩盖你不是九年义务教育的漏网之鱼？
懒得理会李富婆，江凡招手喊来店里美女店员，吩咐美女把柜台里山水画取出来，老乡画的一幅山水画，只不过是一百五六十年前的老乡。
纳尼？李子茜看向店员取出来的《桐山图》山水画，恨不得一巴掌拍死江凡，清末昆山籍画家陈焘的作品，武进士出身，要不是看介绍，真不知道历史上有这号人物！
李子茜无语瞥了眼江凡，大哥，你知道《桐山图》是谁的作品吗？是江南四大才子之一的唐伯虎作品，《桐山图》真迹收藏在故宫博物院，算了，不要同文盲讲什么大道理。
江凡鄙夷斜瞥了眼李子茜，你懂个锤子，哥也是刚知道有一个武进士老乡，可武夫深知明哲保身之道，清朝武将不能收藏前朝作品，而前朝的唐寅同为苏州老乡，英雄惺惺相惜，画中画懂不？
懒得理会李子茜，江凡轻抚《桐山图》山水图，宣纸夹层里的字画宣纸确实有五百多年历史，年份对得上，地点对得上，而且《桃花庵歌》只是源远流长，真迹并未现世，里面作品出自唐伯虎无疑！
不错，刚进店便捡到漏，还是画中画捡漏唐伯虎真迹，一万块钱也不贵，立即吩咐服务员收起来，继续欣赏店里其他作品。

content_en:
"Have you seen it?"
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan with gloating, if any profiteer dared to touch porcelain and hit my aunt on the head, my aunt would let Jiang Fan go. No, let the bodyguard Jiang Fan beat the shop owner and he would not be able to take care of himself!
Jiang Fan secretly rolled his eyes. Cheating is common in the world of cultivation. Monks are more ruthless than ordinary people. Not only do they extort spiritual stones and natural treasures from casual cultivators, but they also often kill people to silence them. He looked at Mrs. Li playfully and kindly reminded her: "As our ancestors said, you can't handle jade, gold can't leave your eyes, and your hands can't point to fish."
"I didn't see it. You even know how to deal with porcelain in Yemen. Let me tell you about a more insidious method of touching porcelain. Some unscrupulous shopkeepers use fishing line or silk thread to tie some fragile porcelain or fake or defective products. They are hard to detect. No one can walk out of the store without spending tens of thousands of dollars."
"The city is full of tricks, I want to go back to the countryside!"
Jiang Fan said with a smile, the merchants in Yanjing are too dark-hearted, and they can think of such despicable methods. Why doesn't lightning kill those unscrupulous merchants?
"Young people, rural roads are also slippery and the routines are more complicated!"
Li Ziqian joked that today's rural people are not as simple as before. Many migrant workers who go to cities to work, some even dare to touch moving cars in order to get a big chance!
After chatting for a while, the bustle of porcelain-making is nothing to look at. Tourists can only admit their defeat and learn from the mistakes. In the future, they should not come to a mixed place like the antique market. Even if they come, they should enter those well-decorated old shops or go shopping for treasures at the street stalls.
The two of them were chatting and laughing as they entered a calligraphy and painting shop. They glanced at the calligraphy and paintings on the wall and on the counter. When they took a closer look at the signature, the corner of Jiang Fan's mouth couldn't help but twitch. The reality of the TV series was really eye-opening.
How should I put it? The owner of the shop must be a relative of a certain big boss in Sucun. Most of the calligraphy and paintings in the shop are copied by famous people from Sucun or Jinling. The prices range from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands, and everyone knows about it.
After leaving the calligraphy and painting shop, Li Ziqian felt a sense of contempt in her heart. The things played here in Jinling were too low-end and were all leftovers from the ones in Yanjing. She looked at Jiang Fan mysteriously, "Do you know how the things played in Yanjing are?"
Alas, this girl will teach you some knowledge. These knowledge are only known by experts. She said quite speechlessly: "Do you know that the new lottery Shuangseqiu, which was launched in the welfare lottery at the beginning of the year (February 16, 2003), is the first lotto-type lottery game in the history of the lottery that has unified game rules, unified lottery drawings, and unified prize pools."
"Some tycoons in Yanjing buy first-prize lottery tickets from all over the country. As long as you win the first prize, you don't have to pay the 25% personal tax. Those tycoons buy the winning lottery tickets at a lottery price of 5 million or even a premium. You will understand later."
Jiang Fan silently gave a thumbs up. Yanjing deserves to be the imperial capital. He admired it and said: "The scalpers in Jinling are still selling train tickets, expert accounts and concert tickets. You, the scalpers in Yanjing, have started selling Shuangseqiu lottery tickets across the country, and you have turned the welfare lottery into a money laundering tool. I admire you!"
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan in surprise. Jiang Fan was just an ordinary college student, and Jiang's mother was just a small boss who couldn't get on the stage. But how could Jiang Fan know all the troubles in the officialdom? Is this also a benefit of being struck by lightning?
Walking into an antique calligraphy and painting shop and glancing at the modern calligraphy and paintings hanging on the wall, Li Ziqian couldn't help sighing depressedly. As Japan's "Four Saints of Business" Kazuo Inamori said, choice is better than hard work, and vision determines the future!
In response to the call for reform and opening up, the National History Museum established a reception department for foreign guests in 1981. The staff often had to pay three yuan for meals out of their own pockets. In order to raise funds for the reception, they could only dispose of the more than 9,000 paintings and calligraphy accumulated in the warehouse at cabbage prices.
Li Keran's exquisite works are priced at eight yuan, which is too expensive; paintings by Wu Zuoren, Lu Yanshao and others are priced at five yuan; Huang Binhong's paintings are unsaleable at one yuan; while Zhang Daqian, Qi Baishi,The works of Xu Beihong, Wu Guanzhong, Fu Baoshi and other masters only cost less than ten yuan, and less than a hundred copies were sold in two years.
I am truly envious. Xu Huachi, the son of Qi Baishi’s close disciple Xu Linlu, accompanied the chairman and his wife of Macau Dafeng Bank on their visit to China. He saw the unsalable calligraphy and paintings in the museum and spent 200,000 to package more than 9,000 paintings and calligraphy. In the future, those calligraphy and paintings may be worth hundreds of millions!
Li Zhiruo couldn't help but sigh secretly. At that time, official institutions such as museums, friendship stores, cultural relics stores, and the Canton Fair across the country only sold antiques overseas. In its heyday, Panjiayuan gathered more than 50 foreign antique dealers, and the annual transaction volume once exceeded the 3 billion mark!
"Fu Po Li, Po Po Li, what are you thinking about?"
Well, I was a little lost in thought. Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan awkwardly and said with emotion: "I remembered something. Last year, the Forbidden City spent 29.99 million yuan to buy the "Yanshan Inscription" by Mi Fu at an auction in Japan. It has 39 words in total and the single word value exceeds 760,000 yuan!"
Jiang Fan was speechless for a moment. Some institutions always received precious cultural relics from the private sector with a certificate of honor and a bonus of 500 yuan, but the Forbidden City actually spent 30 million to bid for cultural relics at a Japanese auction...
"I wonder who Mi Fu is?"
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan playfully. After all, you are also a young man who has accepted the nine-year obligation. You don't even know about Mi Fu, one of the "Four Song Families"!
"Five-colored water floats in Kunlun; at the top of the pool, black clouds emerge; hanging dragon monsters sparkle with electric marks; under the thunder, the Ze thick Kun; extreme changes, the Taoist door is closed!"
Jiang Fan glanced at Li Ziqian with disdain. He read through almost all the books in the library. How can a truly learned and wealthy person be comparable to you ordinary people!
"What?"
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan with a confused look on her face. Being uneducated is not scary, just admit it bravely, but what the hell are you reading to cover up that you are not a fish in the nine-year compulsory education?
Too lazy to pay attention to Mrs. Li, Jiang Fan beckoned to the beautiful clerk in the store and asked the beauty to take out the landscape painting from the counter. The landscape painting painted by the fellow was just that of the fellow from 150 to 60 years ago.
Nani? Li Ziqian looked at the landscape painting "Tongshan Tu" that the clerk took out, and she wanted to slap Jiang Fan to death. It was a work by Chen Tao, a painter from Kunshan in the late Qing Dynasty. He was born in Wu Jinshi. If he hadn't read the introduction, he would have never known that such a figure existed in history!
Li Ziqian glanced at Jiang Fan speechlessly, "Brother, do you know whose work "Tongshan Picture" was? It is the work of Tang Bohu, one of the four great talents in the south of the Yangtze River. The original "Tongshan Picture" is collected in the Palace Museum. Forget it, don't talk to the illiterate.
Jiang Fan sideways glanced at Li Ziqian with disdain, "You know a hammer? I just got to know that there is a fellow martial artist, but the martial artist knows how to protect himself wisely. Generals in the Qing Dynasty cannot collect the works of the previous dynasty, and Tang Yin of the previous dynasty was both a fellow Suzhou fellow. The heroes cherish each other, do you understand the painting within the painting?"
Too lazy to pay attention to Li Ziqian, Jiang Fan gently caressed the landscape painting of "Tongshan Picture". The calligraphy and painting in the rice paper sandwich was indeed more than 500 years old, the year was right, and the location was right. Moreover, "Peach Blossom Temple Song" only has a long history, and the original work has not been extant. The work inside is undoubtedly by Tang Bohu!
Yes, I picked it up as soon as I entered the store. It was an authentic Tang Bohu painting within a painting. It cost only 10,000 yuan. I immediately asked the waiter to put it away and continue to appreciate other works in the store.
